title: Apache Spark
scope: A comprehensive Apache Spark course covering Spark 4.2, PySpark/Scala, SparkSession, DataFrames/Datasets and SQL, Catalyst and Tungsten-style execution, Adaptive Query Execution, joins/shuffles/partitions, files and lakehouse sources, Structured Streaming, Spark Connect, pandas/Arrow interoperability, MLlib, GraphX awareness, deployment, Kubernetes/YARN/Standalone, memory and resource tuning, observability, security, testing, upgrades, and production batch/streaming architecture.
coverage_note: Apache Spark 4.2.0 baseline with current Spark SQL/DataFrame APIs, Structured Streaming, Spark Connect, Scala 2.13-era distribution, Python/PySpark, AQE, modern table/data-source integration, and production deployment practices
